content.comment_body: Hello! Has anyone here worked on connecting a low-resolution encoder to the high-speed digital input of a [product_name]? I need to measure approximately 240 mm of plastic foil within about 2 seconds.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for guidance on integrating a low-resolution encoder with the high-speed digital input of a [product_name] to measure short lengths of moving plastic foil within a brief time period. The discussion focused on whether this approach is feasible and if others have successfully measured small lengths using the high-speed counting function in [product_name] hardware. The only response was a supportive resource link, with no shared hands-on experience or detailed feedback.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that [product_name] can directly connect with low-resolution encoders via high-speed digital inputs and reliably measure short lengths within a limited timeframe.
